instruction.text: Ordne die Bilder den passenden Wörtern zu.
Ordne die Bilder den passenden Wörtern zu.

atoms.a: Where can you buy meat, vegetables, fruits and bread?

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Dialog zwischen Pau und seinen Freunden.

atoms.a: Ich liebe es im Einkaufzentrum einkaufen zu gehen.
atoms.b: I love to go to the ((++shopping_mall market)).
atoms.sound: I love to go to the shopping mall.

atoms.b: Why do you like the ((++mall shop))?
atoms.sound: Why do you like the mall?

atoms.a: Dort gibt es viele verschiedene Geschäfte. Und jeder findet etwas was einem gefällt.
atoms.b: There are a lot of different ((++shops prices)). And everyone finds something they like.
atoms.sound: There are a lot of different shops. And everyone finds something they like.

atoms.b: What are your favourite ((++shops sells)) in a ((++mall shop))?
atoms.sound: What are your favourite shops in a mall?

atoms.a: Ich mag den Musikladen sehr. Ich kaufe immer die neuesten Alben meiner Lieblingsband. Und ich schaue mir gerne die verschiedenen Instrumente an.
atoms.b: I really like the ((++music_shop singers)). I always ((++buy sell)) the newest album by my favourite band. And I like to ((++look_at jump_at)) all the different instruments.
atoms.sound: I really like the music shop. I always buy the newest album by my favourite band. And I like to look at all the different instruments.

atoms.a: Ich mag das Kleidergeschäft am meisten. Sie verkaufen Socken, Schuhe, kurze Hosen, Hemden, Röcke, Schals und mehr.
atoms.b: I like the ((++clothes_shop mall)) the most. They ((++sell show)) socks, shoes, shorts, shirts, skirts, scarfs and more.
atoms.sound: I like the clothes shop the most. They sell socks, shoes, shorts, shirts, skirts, scarfs and more.

atoms.a: Mein Lieblingsgeschäft ist die Bäckerei. Wenn ich hungrig bin, kaufe ich mir leckeres Essen dort, zum Beispiel belegte Brote und Kekse.
atoms.b: My favourite ((++shop shoe)) is the ((++bakery supermarket)). When I am hungry I ((++buy bring)) delicious food there, for example sandwiches and biscuits.
atoms.sound: My favourite shop is the bakery. When I am hungry I buy delicious food there, for example sandwiches and biscuits.

atoms.a: Ich kann mich nicht entscheiden. Ich mag die Buchhandlung, weil ich es liebe zu lesen und sie Bücher verkaufen. Aber ich mag auch das Sportgeschäft.
atoms.b: I can't decide. I like the ((++book_shop music_shop)) because I like to read, and they ((++sell see)) books. But I also like the ((++sports_shop clothes_shop)).
atoms.sound: I can't decide. I like the bookshop because I like to read, and they sell books. But I also like the sports shop.

atoms.a: Wenn das Wetter schön ist, dann mag ich den Markt mehr als das Einkaufszentrum.
atoms.b: If the weather is nice, I like the ((++market mall)) more than the ((++mall market)).
atoms.sound: If the weather is nice, I like the market more than the mall.
